qa.question: Is it possible to digivolve into [Beelzemon: Blast Mode] with this card's [When Digivolving] effect?
qa.answer:
No, it is not.
The card's effect allows digivolution only into a Digimon card whose name is [Beelzemon].

qa.question: I used this card's [When Attacking] effect to digivolve into [Beelzemon] from my trash. At such times, can I use my [EX2-065 Ai & Mako]'s effect to digivolve again into a [Beelzemon: Blast Mode] in my trash?

I used [ST14-02 Impmon] to attack, and its [When Attacking] effect digivolved it into [Beelzemon] from my trash. At such times, can I use this card's effect to again digivolve [Beelzemon] into [Beelzemon: Blast Mode] in my trash?
Does this card's [On Deletion] effect also include this card itself in the number of cards in my trash?
How does this card's "This Digimon can't attack players" effect work if this Digimon is affected by a "make 1 of your opponent's Digimon attack" effect from my opponent?
qa.answer:
If there are targets that this Digimon can attack, such as an opponent's suspended Digimon, it will attack that target.
If the only possible target is the opponent, no attack will occur because of the "This Digimon can't attack players" effect.

qa.question: Can the [On Deletion] effect gained from this card play [Beelzemon: Blast Mode] from my trash?
qa.answer:
No, it can't.
The [On Deletion] effect gained from this card can only play a card whose name is [Beelzemon].

qa.question: If I have 9 or fewer cards in my trash, and I activate this card's [When Digivolving]?effect to trash 4 cards from my deck. If I now have 10 or more cards in my trash, do I gain 1 memory from this card's [All Turns] effect?
Can I activate the "when this card is trashed from the deck" effect when this card is revealed from the deck or when searching/looking at this card in the deck?
qa.answer: No, you can't. You can only activate the "when this card is trashed from the deck" when this card is directly trashed from the deck.

qa.question: Can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect and gain 1 memory even when I have 0 cards in my hand?
qa.answer:
Yes, you can activate this effect.
"return 1 card from your hand on top of your deck" is not a "by <X>, <Y>" effect ("by returning..."), so you gain 1 memory even when you can't perform that action.
However, if you do have cards in your hand, you must return 1 card on top of the deck.

qa.question: Can I activate the "when this card is trashed from the deck" effect when this card is revealed from the deck or when searching/looking at this card in the deck?
qa.answer: No, you can't. You can only activate the "when this card is trashed from the deck" when this card is directly trashed from the deck.

comprehensive-0223.title: <Blocker>
comprehensive-0223.text:
16-5. <Blocker>
16-5-1. <Blocker> is a keyword effect that applies a rule that allows a Digimon with that effect to block. (For details, refer to 12 "Blocking")
16-5-2. <Blocker> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-5-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Blocker>, the number of blocks that can be performed during the block timing is only 1.

comprehensive-0226.title: <Draw>
comprehensive-0226.text:
16-8. <Draw>
16-8-1. <Draw> is a keyword effect where a player draws the cards from their deck according to the number specified in the effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Draw 1>.
16-8-2. <Draw> effects execute processing.
16-8-3. A draw from <Draw> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0233.title: <Rush>
comprehensive-0233.text:
16-15. <Rush>
16-15-1. <Rush> is a keyword effect where the Digimon with this effect can also attack in the same turn it was played.
16-15-2. <Rush> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")

comprehensive-0235.title: <Delay>
comprehensive-0235.text:
16-17. <Delay>
16-17-1. <Delay> is a keyword effect. While a card with this effect is in the battle area, by trashing that card, the effect specified in <Delay> will activate.
16-17-2. The processing from <Delay> is optional. (For details, refer to 15-7 "Optional Processing Conditions")
16-17-3. <Delay> can't be activated the same turn the card with the effect is placed in the battle area.
